edges.fact: Vallejo's Model Color line is their flagship range, offering historical, fantasy, and sci-fi colors known for high pigmentation, excellent flow, and blending.
Vallejo's Game Color line is designed for miniature painters, offering vibrant, bright colors and washes for fantasy and sci-fi miniatures.
Vallejo's Panzer Aces line focuses on World War II armor and military vehicles with authentic colors and washes.
Vallejo's Effects line includes specialized paints and washes for creating realistic rust, dirt, mud, and weathering effects.
Vallejo's Metal Color line is a range of metallic paints for creating realistic metal finishes.
Metal Color - Steel (77.721), a dark, cool gray with a slight blue undertone, is part of Vallejo's Metal Color line.
Metal Color - Aluminum (77.722), a light, warm gray with a slight silver undertone, is part of Vallejo's Metal Color line.
Metal Color - Dark Aluminum (77.723), a medium-dark gray with a slight brown undertone, is part of Vallejo's Metal Color line.
Metal Color - Gunmetal (77.724), a dark, rich metallic color with a slight blue undertone, is part of Vallejo's Metal Color line.
Metal Color - Steel (77.721) is recommended as a base coat to create a realistic steel wheel finish on the Ford Mustang Shelby GT350R model.
Metal Color - Aluminum (77.722) is recommended for a bright, polished aluminum look, drybrushing, and edge highlighting on the Ford Mustang Shelby GT350R model's wheels.
Metal Color - Dark Aluminum (77.723) is recommended as a base coat for a darker, more weathered aluminum finish on the Ford Mustang Shelby GT350R model's wheels.
Metal Color - Gunmetal (77.724) is recommended for a dark, rich metallic finish on the Ford Mustang Shelby GT350R model's wheels.
Grey Wash (76.513) is recommended to add depth and subtle shading to the wheels of the Ford Mustang Shelby GT350R model.
Brown Wash (76.514) is recommended to add depth and subtle shading to the wheels of the Ford Mustang Shelby GT350R model.
Model Varnish (76.551) is recommended as a clear coat to protect the paint and give the Ford Mustang Shelby GT350R model's wheels a glossy finish.
Gloss Varnish (76.552) is recommended as a clear coat to protect the paint and give the Ford Mustang Shelby GT350R model's wheels a glossy finish.
Metal Primer (77.601) is recommended to prime the wheels of the Ford Mustang Shelby GT350R model so the paint adheres properly.
